statusLegend.reported_complete: An experiment-scoped final-contract review found the required scientific components reported. This does not independently certify Toolkit implementation fidelity.
statusLegend.derived_complete: An experiment-scoped final-contract review found the contract reconstructible using a recorded formula or reviewed protocol lineage.
statusLegend.approximation_required: The paper constrains the method but a private asset, calibration, exact renderer field, or other implementation-defining component needs an explicit substitute.
statusLegend.partial: Useful contract evidence is present, but final required components have not all been reviewed or remain unresolved. Coarse 25-field audit parents never promote beyond this state.
statusLegend.conflicting_evidence: Tracked sources or reported quantities conflict and require resolution.
statusLegend.low_confidence: Only automated or explicitly low-confidence candidate evidence is available.
statusLegend.explicitly_absent: The publication explicitly reports that this conditional control family or feature was absent.
statusLegend.not_reported: The required value was not found after the tracked review attempts; protocol lineage or an explicit approximation is needed.
statusLegend.source_unavailable: No inspectable source evidence currently supports a contract-level decision.
statusLegend.not_assessed: The publication/study has no exact joined audit evidence for this contract.
statusLegend.not_applicable: The reviewed evidence marks the contract as not applicable to this study.
statusLegend.composite_requires_split: Evidence exists only for a combined multi-experiment record and must not be copied to an individual experiment row before disaggregation.
statusLegend.mixed_across_studies: The publication's registered study rows have different statuses.

studies.experimentLabel: Bilateral PPS assessment in young and older adults

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: 3000-ms broadband noise, made to loom through intensity manipulation on two speakers.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Original file/generator, calibrated envelope and source mixing are unresolved; do not substitute an unqualified generic noise waveform.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Dynamic broadband noise; sound duration 3 s; ExpyVR controls acoustic/tactile delivery.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Near speaker at 0 cm from the tested hand and far speaker 100 cm away; intensity-based approach.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Main text describes a linear negative relationship between delay and perceived distance, but no reproducible envelope-to-distance calibration is given.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Tested left or right hand.

geometry.value: Near 0 cm and far 100 cm from the hand/near speaker.

motion_mode.value: gain_only_proxy

timing_constraint.value: 3000-ms sound.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Looming sound with delayed hand vibration, silent tactile controls, or sound-only catches; trial types and delays randomized.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Sound onset precedes delayed touch on bimodal trials; unimodal rows omit sound; catches omit touch. Both hand conditions are tested in randomized order.

trial_families.value: 20 targets per three delays, 10 silent controls per delay, 20 sound-only catches in the described recipe.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Press a foot pedal with the right foot within 2000 ms from tactile onset; ignore looming sound.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Young/older group is a between-participant comparison, not a different response route.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Right-foot press as quickly as possible.

response_mode_or_device.value: Foot pedal.

response_window_and_anchor.value: 2000 ms from tactile delivery.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to hand vibration; auditory-only catch trials have no touch target.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: Inter-stimulus intervals randomly selected from 500,750,1000 ms; event anchor not stated.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Do not silently relabel an unspecified inter-stimulus interval as tactile-to-tactile, response-to-next-onset or sound-offset ITI.

policy_type.value: discrete_set

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: Auditory-onset anchored +300,+1500,+2700 ms, labelled far/medium/near.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)

reference_event_and_sign.value: Touch after sound onset is positive.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: 100-ms vibration to the dorsum of the tested hand using a Precision MicroDrives 312-101 motor.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Reported motor specifications and pulse duration describe the authors apparatus; no replacement-actuator calibration is inferred.

body_site_and_side.value: Dorsum of the tested left or right hand.

modality.value: Shaftless vibration motor, model 312-101.

waveform_and_duration.value: 100 ms; device specifications 3 V, 60 mA, 9000 rpm, 150 Hz, 5 g.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: 30 silent controls in the described recipe: 10 at each nominal +300,+1500,+2700-ms delay.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Main Methods gives equivalent delays but does not define the silent-row zero trigger. The fastest mean unisensory RT is an analysis baseline selection, not a fourth trial family.

allocation_rule.value: 10 per each of three silent-condition delays.

family_or_explicit_none.value: tactile_only_soa_matched

resolved_trial_count.value: 30 per described recipe.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.value: 20 sound-only catches in the described recipe; no tactile response target.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Whether the complete recipe is repeated separately for each hand is retained in the allocation gap.

allocation_rule.value: 20 catches per described recipe.

family_or_explicit_none.value: auditory_only_withhold

resolved_trial_count.value: 20 per described recipe.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: Withhold tactile detection response when vibration is absent.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.value: Described recipe totals 110 rows: 20 x 3 targets + 10 x 3 controls + 20 catches; hand crossing is not explicit.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Do not automatically double to 220 without a declared interpretation of the hand factor; the current primary Methods describes both hands but leaves that count crossing implicit.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Both hands tested; current Methods does not explicitly state whether the 110-row recipe is per hand or whole-session total.

factor_dimensions.value: Three delays x bimodal/unimodal family, catch family and both tested hands; young/older groups.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 60 bimodal targets, 30 silent controls and 20 catches in the described recipe.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.value: Hand order randomized; PPS block count and block composition are not stated.
contracts.pageOrSection: Section 2.2.3, journal pp. 60-61 (PDF pp. 5-6)
contracts.evidenceNote: Five blocks in section 2.2.1 belong to body-landmark localization, not the PPS task. Subsequent sound localization is also a separate supporting task.

within_block_randomization.value: Delays and trial types randomized; left/right hand condition order randomized among participants.

studies.label: Functional organization of distance-dependent audio-tactile integration is different in rear and front spaces. (a)

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: A 3250 ms burst train sampled at 44.1 kHz is rendered with Max/MSP 6.1.10 and Spat. Eight stimuli cross fixed/looming sound with four azimuths. Original materials are explicitly unavailable.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2
contracts.evidenceNote: The transparency statement on p. 233 says study materials are not publicly available. The preserved paper description is not an original stimulus asset.

level_envelope_calibration.value: No complete numeric level law, output SPL calibration, reflection/reverberation settings or transfer function is supplied.

renderer_apparatus.value: Max/MSP 6.1.10 with Spat; non-individual LISTEN HRTFs; simulated direct sound, early reflections and late reverberation; Beyer Dynamics DT 770 headphones.

source_mode.value: Synthesized spatial burst-train audio.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: No original waveform, noise recipe, seed, burst-envelope timing or selected LISTEN subject is supplied in this article. Its Methods refers to Hobeika 2020; details were not silently borrowed.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: 3250 ms burst train; 44,100 Hz digitization.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Looming sound travels toward the head at ear level from 640 cm to 20 cm at reported 210 cm/s. Fixed controls stay at 640 cm. Azimuths are +45°, −45°, +135°, −135°. Exact movement onset within the 3250 ms sound is unresolved.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2
contracts.derivationNote: (640−20)/210 = 2.95238095 s. This does not justify assuming that the entire 3.25 s waveform is linear motion, nor inventing a hold. The first and last in-sound tactile anchors are 105 and 3050 ms.

attenuation_law.value: Spat simulation is described but its executable distance-level law is not given.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Head center at ear level. Hands are together against the trunk at the midsagittal plane; the authors interpret this as peri-trunk rather than isolated peri-hand PPS.

geometry.value: Radii 640→20 cm for looming and 640 cm fixed. Positive azimuth denotes left: front +45/−45°, rear +135/−135°.

motion_mode.value: Looming approach and fixed-distance comparator.

padding_or_holds.value: 300 ms silence precedes sound; 700–1100 ms silence follows. No explicit stationary hold within the sound is specified.

timing_constraint.value: Sound duration is 3250 ms and speed is 210 cm/s. The 620 cm radial path takes about 2952 ms at that speed; complete movement timing/offset is not specified.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Each trial contains 300 ms silence, 3250 ms fixed or looming sound, then 700–1100 ms silence. Touch occurs at one of eight sound-relative delays, or is omitted for an auditory-only catch. Pre/post controls retain the trial sound outside the tactile event.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2
contracts.derivationNote: Trial duration = 300+3250+(700 to 1100) ms. Add the 300 ms prefix to each sound-relative touch onset. The 20 ms pulse is contained at both endpoints.

condition_intermixing.value: Fixed and looming trials are randomized within each block.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Silence → one fixed/looming sound in the current hemifield → silence. A single left-index tactile pulse appears at the selected delay or is absent.

trial_families.value: Fixed/looming audio with touch; pre/post touch controls; sound-only no-touch catch trials.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Nominal trial duration is 4250–4650 ms. The −250 ms touch starts 50 ms after trial start; the +3500 ms touch starts 3800 ms after trial start.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Press a response button with the right index finger immediately after a left-index vibration, ignore sound, and avoid anticipation. No numeric acquisition timeout is reported.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Speeded button press on tactile detection; no instructed sound response.

response_mode_or_device.value: Right-index response button; Presentation software records RTs.

response_window_and_anchor.value: Tactile RT is the reported endpoint, but the numeric online response window and hardware latency compensation are not specified. Offline 100–1000 ms filters are not a timeout.

scoring_rule.value: Misses and catch false alarms are assessed. RTs below 100 or above 1000 ms are excluded offline; log RTs are analyzed.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Touch is the response target; sound-only catches omit it.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: A fixed 300 ms silence precedes each sound. The following silence is randomly distributed from 700 to 1100 ms. The distribution family and sampling granularity are not stated.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2

distribution.value: Uniformity, discrete step size and random-sequence seed are not reported.

policy_type.value: Fixed prefix plus variable post-sound silence.

randomization.value: Post-sound interval is described as randomly distributed.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: Prefix ends at sound onset; suffix starts at the 3250 ms sound offset.

values_or_range.value: 300 ms prefix; 700–1100 ms suffix.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: Touch-minus-sound onset is −250, +105, +1625, +2385, +2765, +2955, +3050 and +3500 ms. The same timing grid crosses fixed/looming and all four directions.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2

direction_specific_pairing.value: Identical SOAs for both sound modes and all azimuths. Fixed controls remain 640 cm at every SOA.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: −250, 105, 1625, 2385, 2765, 2955, 3050, 3500 ms. The six interior anchors correspond to reported depths 640, 320, 160, 80, 40, 20 cm.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Delay is measured from sound onset; negative values precede sound.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: A 20 ms, 250 Hz sinusoid drives a miniature 28 mm speaker touching the palmar surface of the left index finger.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2

body_site_and_side.value: Palmar left index finger; both hands palm-down, adjacent and in contact with the trunk.

external_trigger.value: Presentation controls delivery, but no measured stimulus/response latency or trigger correction is supplied.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: 250 Hz. The level is adjusted to be easily detected through touch while inaudible in silence; detection is rechecked after each block.

intensity_or_calibration.value: No numeric amplitude, displacement, acceleration or individual threshold rule is reported.

modality.value: Vibrotactile stimulation.

waveform_and_duration.value: 20 ms sinusoidal pulse.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: Two distinct control structures are required: fixed-distance sound at all eight delays, and pre/post-sound touch anchors in both sound modes. They must not be collapsed into silent whole-trial baselines.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2
contracts.derivationNote: Endpoints: 2 modes×4 azimuths×2 endpoints×20 = 320. Fixed interior: 1×4×6×20 = 480. All fixed rows = 640, of which 160 already belong to the endpoint group.

allocation_rule.value: Twenty repetitions for every sound-mode × hemifield × side × delay cell.

crossing_rule.value: Endpoint controls cross both sound modes and all four azimuths. Fixed in-sound controls cross six interior delays and all four azimuths.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Fixed-distance expectancy comparator plus pre/post endpoint tactile controls within sounding trials.

resolved_trial_count.value: 320 endpoint rows across both sound modes, plus 480 fixed-sound interior rows. Their union is 800 distinct control rows; do not double-count the 160 fixed endpoint rows.

timing_and_anchor.value: Fixed sound stays 640 cm; endpoints are −250/+3500 ms relative to sound onset.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.value: There are 320 auditory-only no-touch catches overall, eight in each of 40 blocks (20% of all 1600 trials). Exact catch allocation between sound modes and left/right sources is not specified.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2

allocation_rule.value: Eight catches per block; total 320.

crossing_rule.value: No exact mode/side distribution for the catch rows is given; equal splitting must not be inferred from the 20% total.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Auditory-only catch with touch omitted.

resolved_trial_count.value: 320 per participant across both sessions.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No tactile target; participant should withhold the response.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.value: Twenty repeats of 64 experimental cells give 1280 touch trials. Adding 320 catches yields 1600 trials per participant across two sessions.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2
contracts.derivationNote: 2×2×2×8×20=1280; 1280+320=1600. Each of 40 blocks contains 32 experimental and 8 catch rows.

derived_total_reconciliation.value: 480 looming interior +480 fixed interior +320 endpoint rows +320 catches =1600.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Catches are a separate eight-per-block family and are not included in the 20 repetitions.

factor_dimensions.value: 2 sound modes × 2 hemifields × 2 sides × 8 touch delays.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 20 repetitions per experimental cell; 1280 experimental trials and 320 catches.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.value: Front and rear hemifields are tested on separate days, counterbalanced across participants. Each session has 20 blocks containing 32 experimental plus eight catch trials.
contracts.pageOrSection: Author-uploaded published-layout full-text transcription, Cortex 194 (2026), pp. 222–225; Methods 2.1–2.3 and Results 3.1–3.2

block_composition.value: 32 touch trials +8 catches; hemifield held constant within a session.

block_count.value: 20 blocks per session, 40 overall.

block_order_or_counterbalancing.value: Front/rear session order is counterbalanced. A 1 min break is allowed between blocks and a mandatory 10 min break occurs halfway through.

pool_repeat_or_distribution.value: Overall experimental-cell repetition is 20; exact per-block cell balancing is not explicitly stated.

sequence_constraints.value: Exact per-block assignment of delays and sides, run-length limits, random seed and constrained catch placement are not reported.

within_block_randomization.value: Fixed and looming trials are randomized within blocks.

studies.label: Capturing the dynamics of peripersonal space by integrating expectancy effects and sound propagation properties. (a)
studies.experimentLabel: Logarithmic/pseudo-linear sampling with fixed and looming controls

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: 3250-ms binaural Gaussian-white-noise burst train at 44.1 kHz; 33 bursts, each 30 ms with 10-ms ramps and 65-ms inter-burst interval.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: Table 1 reports direct/room levels at distance anchors relative to 20-cm direct sound, but original noise realization, HRTF subject/filter and complete room/render settings are unresolved.

source_mode.value: imported_asset

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: MATLAB-generated intensity-equalized bursts rendered with Max/MSP 6.1.10 Spat, LISTEN nonindividual HRTF and 200-ms room reverberation. Early reflections arrive within a 40-degree cone; diffuse late tail.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Right-frontal source at paper azimuth -60 degrees, head-centred ear level; fixed 640 cm or approach 640 to 20 cm at stated 210 cm/s.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: Do not relabel -60 degrees as left using another coordinate convention. The 620-cm displacement at 210 cm/s is about 2.952 s, not the full 3.25-s waveform; source does not explicitly state motion onset/tail partition.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Head centre, ear level; paper explicitly calls -60 degrees the right hemispace.

geometry.value: Looming 640 to 20 cm; fixed control 640 cm. Early-reflection cone aperture 40 degrees around direct-source incidence.

motion_mode.value: spatialized_approach versus fixed source

timing_constraint.value: 3250-ms total waveform includes reverberation tail; stated motion speed 210 cm/s.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: 300-ms leading silence, 3250-ms fixed/looming sound, 700-1100-ms trailing silence; touch before, during or after sound, or no-touch catch.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Leading silence -> selected auditory asset with optional delayed touch -> trailing silence. During-sound touch is delivered 10 ms after the selected burst onset.

trial_families.value: Two distance-sampling sessions x fixed/looming sound x six during-sound delays plus two silent-period anchors; auditory-only catches.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Press a button with the right finger on detecting left-index vibration; ignore sound and avoid anticipation.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: Section 3.1 includes RTs of 100-1000 ms after stimulus onset in analysis; this is not an explicit online timeout or response-collection window.

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Right-finger button press as quickly as possible.

response_mode_or_device.value: Button, recorded with Presentation software; precise hardware unspecified.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Respond to tactile targets and withhold on auditory-only catches.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: 300-ms leading silence and random 700-1100-ms trailing silence after audio offset.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: The source says randomly varying, not uniformly distributed; preserve the two intervals.

policy_type.value: Fixed leading period plus random trailing range.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: 300 ms before sound onset; 700-1100 ms after sound offset.

values_or_range.value: 300 ms leading; 700-1100 ms trailing.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: Rendered current Table 2 was inspected. Do not add the 300-ms leading silence to sound-onset SOAs. The pseudo-linear set is intentionally nonuniform: one 140-cm step and otherwise 120-cm steps.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Table 2 explicitly anchors positive delays to sound onset; touch occurs 10 ms after a selected burst onset.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: 20-ms 250-Hz sinusoid through a 28-mm miniature loudspeaker on the left index palmar surface.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: Reported detectability/inaudibility belongs to the authors apparatus, not a qualified PPS Kit actuator.

body_site_and_side.value: Palmar surface of left index finger.

modality.value: Miniature-loudspeaker vibration.

waveform_and_duration.value: 250-Hz sinusoid, 20 ms.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: Fixed 640-cm controls plus silent-period tactile anchors at -250 and +3500 ms; overlapping control union is 480 target rows.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: The two control families overlap; do not sum them to 576 or infer a wholly audio-free trial.
contracts.derivationNote: Reported 24 repetitions per 32-cell factorial: fixed-family subset 384, endpoint subset 192, intersection 96, union 480.

allocation_rule.value: 24 repeats x 2 sessions x 8 delays = 384 fixed targets; 24 x 2 sessions x 2 sounds x 2 silent anchors = 192 endpoint targets.

family_or_explicit_none.value: static_or_fixed_distance_expectancy_control plus tactile_only_endpoint_pre_post

resolved_trial_count.value: 480 unique control targets = 384 fixed + 192 endpoints - 96 fixed endpoints.

timing_and_anchor.value: Fixed sound at all eight touch delays; pre/post touch is -250/+3500 ms from sound onset, including rows containing sound later/earlier.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.value: 384 auditory-only catches overall: 24 per 72-trial block x eight blocks x two sessions; withhold tactile response.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.evidenceNote: Equal catch split by fixed/looming sound is not explicitly specified; block count is resolved independently.

allocation_rule.value: 24 catches per block, eight blocks per session, two sessions.

family_or_explicit_none.value: auditory_only_withhold

resolved_trial_count.value: 384 total explicitly stated.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No touch target; ignore sound and withhold response.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.value: 1152 total rows across two sessions: 768 tactile targets and 384 catches; 576 rows per session.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2
contracts.derivationNote: Reported target/catch totals sum to 1152; eight 72-row blocks per each of two sessions independently give 1152.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Tactile targets include silent-period baselines; subsequent auditory discomfort assessments are separate.

factor_dimensions.value: 2 distance distributions x 2 sound movements x 8 touch delays = 32 tactile cells.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 24 per tactile cell = 768 targets; 384 catches; 48 target plus 24 catch rows per block.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.value: Two counterbalanced distance-sampling sessions, each eight 72-row blocks, on different days no more than three days apart.
contracts.pageOrSection: Sections 2.2-2.3.1, manuscript pp. 3-5; Tables 1-2

block_composition.value: 48 tactile targets + 24 catches per block, about five minutes; target and catch trials randomly intermingled.

block_count.value: Eight blocks per session, sixteen across the experiment.

within_block_randomization.value: Random target/catch intermixing; logarithmic/pseudo-linear session order counterbalanced.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Trial begins with a 4–8 s jittered interval, followed by AT-near, AT-far, T, A-near or A-far. In AT trials sound begins 40 ms after touch. condition_intermixing.value: Randomly intermingled conditions.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Exact response-window origin across modalities is not further specified.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Press a key with the right index finger as fast as possible to touch; ignore sounds and withhold on auditory-only catches. Maximum response time is 1 s, with exact modality-specific origin unspecified. Blink after response; otherwise fixate behind far speaker. Offline RT <100 ms or beyond two condition SD is separate analysis.

scoring_rule.value: Offline RT <100 ms and beyond two within-condition SD excluded. Fixate dot; blink after response.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Fixed near/far sources; no trajectory directions.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: One AT SOA: −0.040 s, same in near/far conditions.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Tactile onset minus auditory onset: audio follows touch by 40 ms, giving −40 ms.

contracts.label: Tactile target

Trigger/interface details remain unspecified.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: Twice individual detection threshold; final mean 3.7 ± 0.7 mA, range 2.5–5.1 mA.

intensity_or_calibration.value: Method of limits, twice threshold; redetermined after blocks with electrode-site alternation.

modality.value: Electrical stimulation via Digitimer DS7A constant-current stimulator.

waveform_and_duration.value: Single 200 µs square pulse.

studies.label: Audio-Tactile and Peripersonal Space Processing Around the Trunk in Human Parietal and Temporal Cortex: An Intracranial EEG Study. (a)

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: 3000-ms approaching white-noise binaural recording made using two eight-speaker arrays over2m and a head-model microphone; ER-4P insert-earphone playback.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures
contracts.evidenceNote: Original audio PCM, sampling rate, source realization, level envelope and SPL/calibration are not provided. A generated HRTF substitute is not the original recording.

source_mode.value: imported_asset

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: White noise prerecorded from two arrays of eight speakers,2m total length, Omni Binaural Microphone head model; Etymotic ER-4P earphones.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: Frontal body-centred approach with maximal simulated distance2m, duration3s and reported nominal speed0.66m/s; nominal touch distances1.7,1.0,0.3m.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures
contracts.evidenceNote: Do not infer a measured zero-distance endpoint or claim every jittered pulse occurs at the exact nominal distance. The original recording/transfer function remains unresolved.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Patient body/trunk; upper body reclined approximately135degrees relative to the rest of the body, eyes closed.

geometry.value: Maximal simulated distance2m, approach from front; nominal pulse distance labels1.7,1.0,0.3m.

motion_mode.value: approach via recorded physical-array acoustics

timing_constraint.value: 3-s waveform with stated0.66m/s speed.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Three randomized trial families: A, T and AT. Each T/AT trial contains three successive tactile events.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures
contracts.evidenceNote: Three tactile events occur within each T/AT trial; do not expand them into three single-target trials.

condition_intermixing.value: 85 trials of each A/T/AT family presented randomly.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: A: 3000-ms approaching white noise; T: three touches without sound; AT: same three touches with sound.

trial_families.value: Auditory-only A control, tactile-only T control, and multisensory AT.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Nominal tactile events at 500, 1500 and 2500 ms; each delay jittered by 0-200 ms in 50-ms steps.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Passive iEEG task: attend to sound and touch with eyes closed; no overt response requested.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Attend to auditory and tactile stimulation while reclined, eyes closed.

response_mode_or_device.value: No overt response device/task.

response_window_and_anchor.value: Not applicable: electrophysiological acquisition without behavioral response deadline.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: No behavioral detection or catch-response rule.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: Tactile-delay jitter 0-200 ms in 50-ms steps; ITI randomly selected/shuffled among 1.4, 1.7 and 1.9 s.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures
contracts.evidenceNote: Selection probabilities and the exact ITI endpoint convention are not specified; do not silently assert uniform draws.

policy_type.value: Discrete tactile-event jitter plus discrete intertrial intervals.

randomization.value: Randomized ITI choice/order.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: Each nominal tactile delay and interval between trials.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: Three tactile events per T/AT trial at nominal 500,1500,2500 ms; in AT these are relative to sound onset.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures
contracts.evidenceNote: Three nominal delays per trial, with discrete0-200-msjitter. Preserve the printed unit error and nominal distance labels; no exact per-jitter acoustic position mapping is supplied.
contracts.derivationNote: Normalize the printed third delay2500m to2500ms from the parallel500/1500-ms timing syntax and3-s trial. The typo persists in preprint and final XML, so the final is not an independent textual correction.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Approach only; nominal far/middle/close distances 1.7,1.0,0.3 m.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: 500,1500,2500 ms, with 0-200-ms jitter in 50-ms steps.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Trial onset for T; common trial/sound onset for AT.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: Three100-ms vibrations per T/AT trial at upper sternum; Precision MicroDrives312-101 motor with nominal150Hz specification.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures
contracts.evidenceNote: Motor specifications and command duration do not establish a measured150-Hz delivered waveform, trigger latency or participant-specific threshold calibration; no hardware qualification is inferred.

body_site_and_side.value: Upper sternum/chest.

modality.value: Shaftless motor312-101; purpose-built Arduino with10kHzrefresh and ExpyVR serial control.

waveform_and_duration.value: 100-ms commanded pulse; motor specifications3V,60mA,9000rpm,150Hz,5g,113mm2,maximum speed reached in50ms.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: 85 tactile-only T control trials, each with three tactile events; separate A controls remain auditory-only.
contracts.pageOrSection: Methods, Material and Apparatus; Procedures
contracts.evidenceNote: Prestimulus EEG baseline correction is an analysis operation, not an additional trial family.

allocation_rule.value: 85 T trials in the global randomized pool.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Unisensory tactile T control.

resolved_trial_count.value: 85 tactile-only control trials.

timing_and_anchor.value: 500,1500,2500 ms after T-trial onset, with reported jitter.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics

contracts.label: SOA schedule

contracts.pageOrSection: Published pp. 643–644 (PDF pp. 2–3), Method / Procedure and Materials

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Say “tah” promptly for weak touch; ignore sound and do not respond to strong touch or catches.

response_mode_or_device.value: Voice-activated relay; XGen software controls presentation and records responses.

response_window_and_anchor.value: RT is interpreted relative to tactile delivery, but the numeric online window and hardware latency compensation are not specified. Offline trimming is not an acquisition deadline.

scoring_rule.value: Tactile RT, omissions and false alarms. RT more than two standard deviations from the mean is trimmed offline.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Weak touch is always the target; strong touch and sound-only catches require withholding.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: Each trial lasts approximately 3 s. A separate intertrial interval, exact event anchors and jitter distribution are not supplied.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published article pp.2961–2962 / PDF pp.6–7, Experiment 2 Materials, Procedure and Data Analysis; explicitly inherited Experiment 1B task

distribution.value: No jitter distribution or sampling step.

policy_type.value: The approximate cycle does not establish a fixed or variable ITI policy.

randomization.value: No timing-sequence generation procedure.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: The paper does not isolate stimulus offset, response completion or next-trial onset as the ITI anchor.

values_or_range.value: Approximately 3 s per trial.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: Using tactile onset minus emitted-audio onset, near SOA is 0 ms and far SOA is +5 ms. The far sound is commanded early to compensate its longer travel time, not to create a 5 ms perceptual lag.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published article pp.2961–2962 / PDF pp.6–7, Experiment 2 Materials, Procedure and Data Analysis; explicitly inherited Experiment 1B task
contracts.derivationNote: For far sound, t_audio = t_touch − 5 ms; therefore t_touch − t_audio = +5 ms. Perceptual arrival was intended to align.

direction_specific_pairing.value: Near versus far static speaker condition; no looming direction.

ordered_soa_values_or_derivable_distance.value: Canonical tactile-minus-emitted-audio onset: near 0 ms, far +5 ms.

reference_event_and_sign.value: The source describes electrical command timing: near sound and touch together; far sound begins 5 ms before touch.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: The right index receives a single rectangular monophasic electrical pulse lasting 100 microseconds. Weak and strong intensities are calibrated individually. The article calls the stimulators constant-current but calls the pulse constant-voltage; retain this unresolved apparatus wording.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published article pp.2961–2962 / PDF pp.6–7, Experiment 2 Materials, Procedure and Data Analysis; explicitly inherited Experiment 1B task
contracts.evidenceNote: These are source apparatus descriptions, not new calibration measurements or device-operation instructions. A software 100 ms vibration is not the reported 100 microsecond electrical pulse.

body_site_and_side.value: Dorsal surface of the right index finger.

external_trigger.value: No measured latency or explicit trigger interface/correction is supplied.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: Materials names constant-current DS7A stimulators, then describes a constant-voltage pulse. Do not silently choose one electrical-output interpretation.

intensity_or_calibration.value: Weak level must be detected on at least 9 of 10 tests; strong is 1.5 times weak, checked for complete detection and perfect weak/strong discrimination. The full historical calibration procedure is in the source.

modality.value: Electrocutaneous stimulation through two pairs of electrodes and two DS7A stimulators.

waveform_and_duration.value: Single rectangular monophasic pulse, 100 microseconds (0.1 ms), visually checked on PDF p.3.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: There is no no-sound tactile trial family. The no-rTMS baseline is a complete sounding 140-trial task block; it is not an audio-muted baseline row.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published article pp.2961–2962 / PDF pp.6–7, Experiment 2 Materials, Procedure and Data Analysis; explicitly inherited Experiment 1B task

allocation_rule.value: Not applicable because the no-sound baseline family is explicitly absent.

crossing_rule.value: Not applicable because the no-sound baseline family is explicitly absent.

family_or_explicit_none.value: No separate no-sound tactile baseline family in the enumerated task.

resolved_trial_count.value: Not applicable because the no-sound baseline family is explicitly absent.

timing_and_anchor.value: Not applicable because the no-sound baseline family is explicitly absent.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.value: Twenty sound-only catches (10 near, 10 far) require withholding. Sixty strong-touch nontargets are a separate withholding family.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published article pp.2961–2962 / PDF pp.6–7, Experiment 2 Materials, Procedure and Data Analysis; explicitly inherited Experiment 1B task
contracts.evidenceNote: Experiment 2 restates 20 sound-only catches and explicitly inherits Experiment 1B except for posture; its 10 near/10 far split is therefore inherited rather than separately restated.
contracts.derivationNote: 2×10=20 sound-only catches; 2×30=60 strong nontargets. The remaining 60 rows are weak targets.

allocation_rule.value: 10 near plus 10 far catches; 30 strong-touch events at each speaker.

crossing_rule.value: Both sound-only and strong-touch families cross near/far speaker conditions.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Auditory-only labeled catches and separate strong-touch nontargets.

resolved_trial_count.value: 20 labeled catches plus 60 strong-touch nontargets =80 withholding rows per enumerated 140-trial task.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: Withhold for sound-only and strong touch; respond only to weak touch.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.value: Each of four blocks contains 30 trials per weak/strong × near/far cell plus 20 catches: 140 per block, 560 across the two-day experiment.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published article pp.2961–2962 / PDF pp.6–7, Experiment 2 Materials, Procedure and Data Analysis; explicitly inherited Experiment 1B task
contracts.derivationNote: The source explicitly links 140 trials to each approximately 7-minute block; four such blocks give 560, unlike the unresolved repetition scope in Experiment 1.

derived_total_reconciliation.value: 4×(4×30+20)=560 task rows: 240 weak targets, 240 strong nontargets and 80 sound-only catches.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Arm remains forward; tactile-only trials remain absent. Motor-threshold calibration and the rTMS trains are not acquisition task rows.

factor_dimensions.value: 2 tactile intensities ×2 sound distances ×4 block conditions: no-rTMS, post-vPMc, post-PPc and post-V1.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 30 in each of four tactile/audio cells, 20 catches and 140 trials per block; four blocks total.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.value: Four blocks run over two days: a no-rTMS block and three blocks immediately after rTMS over vPMc, PPc or V1. Post-rTMS order is counterbalanced. Baseline placement conflicts between Procedure and Data Analysis.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published article pp.2961–2962 / PDF pp.6–7, Experiment 2 Materials, Procedure and Data Analysis; explicitly inherited Experiment 1B task
contracts.evidenceNote: rTMS is an experimental manipulation before genuine behavioral audiotactile acquisition. MEP recording is used for intensity calibration here, not as this task’s outcome.

block_composition.value: 140 trials in each block; same behavioral audiotactile task.

block_count.value: Four task blocks over two days.

block_order_or_counterbalancing.value: Procedure: no-rTMS baseline first in six participants and last in the remaining four. Data Analysis: half first and half last, implying five/five. Do not reconcile silently.

pool_repeat_or_distribution.value: The complete 140-trial task is repeated in all four conditions.

sequence_constraints.value: At least one hour separates blocks within a session; post-rTMS tasks follow the stimulation train.

within_block_randomization.value: No exact trial sequence, seed or constrained allocation is reported.

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: Pink noise in every trial, volume modulated across two loudspeakers. No sample rate, source duration, exact envelope or level is given in these Methods. A citation to Maister does not transfer its complete stimulus.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Pink noise present in every trial.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics

timing_constraint.value: Sound duration and physical/perceptual speed law not specified.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: Seated, blindfolded participants receive one of five sound-to-tap delays, or a no-tap catch. One randomised 65-trial PPS task precedes the FBI. Detailed ITI, response deadline and sound offsets are absent.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: Sound offsets, trial length and online response window absent.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Respond to the right-middle-finger tap as quickly as possible with a left-hand button; ignore the pink noise. Arduino and LabVIEW 8 control timing and record RT. contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: IN/OUT apparent motion from two-speaker intensity fades. Right hand rests palm-down beside body; near speaker on table by hand, far speaker on floor approximately 100 cm from near speaker. Sound lasts 3 s. Full 3D geometry and perceived distance–time law are not established.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published PDF pp. 2–3, Procedures and Materials; Figure 1 p. 4

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Right hand resting palm-down on table beside body.

padding_or_holds.value: 1000 ms silence before and after sound.

timing_constraint.value: 3 s sound. Nominal speaker separation divided by duration is not a measured constant perceived velocity.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: A 5000 ms nominal trial comprises 1000 ms silence, 3000 ms IN/OUT sound and 1000 ms silence. Touch may occur during sound or in pre/post silence; those control trials retain sound elsewhere. Auditory-only catches omit touch. Conditions and timings are randomly intermingled.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published PDF pp. 2–3, Procedures and Materials; Figure 1 p. 4
contracts.derivationNote: 1000 ms pre-sound + 3000 ms sound + 1000 ms post-sound = 5000 ms nominal timeline; no extra ITI or response window is inferred.

trial_families.value: IN/OUT targets at T0–T6 and auditory-only catches.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: 1000 + 3000 + 1000 = 5000 ms nominal trial; response timeout not specified.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Say TAH as rapidly as possible to touch while ignoring sound; withhold when touch is absent. Voice-activated relay with C.I.R.O. records RT. No numeric response timeout or relay latency correction is reported.

studies.label: The Impact of Looming Sound Duration on Peripersonal Space Measurement (a)

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.value: Pink noise is spatialized in MATLAB using HRTFs to approach laterally from the right. The 2 s protocol uses a 100 cm start; the 3 s protocol uses 150 cm. Original waveform, HRTF identity and output level are not supplied.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

level_envelope_calibration.value: Attenuation and propagation are described but no complete numeric law, headphone calibration or presentation SPL is specified.

renderer_apparatus.value: MATLAB HRTF procedure based on Pfeiffer et al.2018; propagation and attenuation for room-temperature air, without added reverberation. Sennheiser HDA 300 headphones; PsychToolBox and WASAPI DAC.

source_mode.value: Synthesized binaural pink noise.

source_recipe_or_asset_provenance.value: No exact noise seed, asset checksum, HRTF dataset/subject or full executable code is supplied in this proceedings paper.

stimulus_identity_or_asset.value: Two duration-specific stereo stimuli,2 s and 3 s.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: For the 2 s protocol, the virtual source approaches from 100 cm to 0 cm at 50 cm/s along a straight lateral path toward the head. The 3 s version starts 150 cm away at the same speed.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6
contracts.evidenceNote: Duration and initial distance covary at fixed velocity. This is not a duration-only waveform manipulation over a fixed spatial path.

attenuation_law.value: Propagation/attenuation follows the cited approach, but its numeric law at the 0 cm endpoint is not supplied.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Lateral approach from the right toward the listener/head. Right palm receives touch.

geometry.value: 2 s:100→0 cm;3 s:150→0 cm. Discussion explicitly identifies 0 cm as the intended endpoint.

motion_mode.value: Looming approach only.

padding_or_holds.value: No additional auditory hold or full post-sound trial margin is specified.

timing_constraint.value: Constant 50 cm/s,2 s or 3 s according to protocol.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: A fixation cross precedes trial onset by 1000 ms. Audio-tactile targets contain looming sound plus a 200 ms touch at one of seven delays. Tactile-only baselines use those same delays; sound-only catches omit touch.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

condition_intermixing.value: Twenty-one catches are interspersed with the 224 target/baseline trials.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Fixation cross →1000 ms→trial/audio onset; touch at the chosen delay or no touch in catches. Baseline trials omit the sound.

trial_families.value: Audio-tactile targets, tactile-only baselines, auditory-only no-touch catches.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: The sound/tactile tracks last 2 s or 3 s; exact trial end, post-response waiting period and separate ITI are not reported.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Press a left-hand response button as soon as the right-palm vibration is felt; withhold on auditory-only catches. RT is keypress time relative to trial onset minus the selected touch delay.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Speeded press on tactile detection while maintaining fixation.

response_mode_or_device.value: Cherry MX Blue response button within reach of the left hand.

response_window_and_anchor.value: Tactile anchor is explicit, but no numeric online timeout or measured button latency correction is reported.

scoring_rule.value: Negative RTs and trials with multiple presses are excluded. Per-delay/condition RTs beyond 2.5 SD are trimmed offline.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Touch requires response; no-touch catch requires withholding.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: The fixation-to-trial-onset interval is fixed at 1000 ms. Independent intertrial timing and post-sound jitter are not specified.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

distribution.value: No independent ITI distribution or range is supplied.

policy_type.value: Fixed foreperiod before trial onset.

randomization.value: Randomization of foreperiod/ITI is not stated; interspersed catch order does not establish timing jitter.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: 1000 ms after fixation-cross appearance; sound begins at trial onset on sounding trials.

values_or_range.value: 1000 ms fixed foreperiod.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: The 2 s protocol uses seven touch onsets at 250,500,750,1000,1250,1500,1750 ms after trial/sound onset. Baselines use the same trial-relative delays without sound.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

direction_specific_pairing.value: Only right-to-head looming direction; same seven delays for tactile-only baseline.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Positive tactile onset after nominal trial onset, which is sound onset on audio-tactile trials.

contracts.evidenceNote: Methods 2.2 describes a 15×15×1 cm pad; Methods 2.4 describes 10×10×1 cm. Preserve this apparatus discrepancy; 80 Hz and 200 ms are consistently reported.

body_site_and_side.value: Right palm supported on a molded silicone pad.

external_trigger.value: Separate tactile audio track starts simultaneously with the binaural track through the DAC.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: Frequency 80 Hz; pulse duration 200 ms.

intensity_or_calibration.value: Numeric amplitude/displacement and individual tactile-threshold calibration are not reported.

modality.value: Audio-driven vibrotactile actuator.

waveform_and_duration.value: 80 Hz sawtooth synthesized in Audacity, lasting 200 ms.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: A full set of tactile-only baselines matches all seven delays, with 16 repetitions per delay and no looming sound.

crossing_rule.value: Crosses every delay within each duration-specific protocol.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Tactile-only SOA-matched trials.

resolved_trial_count.value: 112 baseline trials per duration protocol.

timing_and_anchor.value: The same seven trial-relative touch onsets as the audio-tactile trials; sound omitted.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No tactile stimulation; withhold button press.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.value: 16 repeats×7 delays×2 modalities yields 224 tactile trials;21 additional catches produce 245 per duration protocol. Both protocols together give 490 trials before the separate practice.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.value: For the 3 s protocol, the source approaches from 150 cm to 0 cm at 50 cm/s along a straight lateral path toward the head. Duration and starting distance differ together from the 2 s protocol.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6
contracts.evidenceNote: Duration and initial distance covary at fixed velocity. This is not a duration-only waveform manipulation over a fixed spatial path.

attenuation_law.value: Propagation/attenuation follows the cited approach, but its numeric law at the 0 cm endpoint is not supplied.

coordinate_frame_body_anchor.value: Lateral approach from the right toward the listener/head. Right palm receives touch.

geometry.value: 2 s:100→0 cm;3 s:150→0 cm. Discussion explicitly identifies 0 cm as the intended endpoint.

motion_mode.value: Looming approach only.

padding_or_holds.value: No additional auditory hold or full post-sound trial margin is specified.

timing_constraint.value: Constant 50 cm/s,2 s or 3 s according to protocol.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.value: A fixation cross precedes trial onset by 1000 ms. Audio-tactile targets contain looming sound plus a 200 ms touch at one of seven delays. Tactile-only baselines use those same delays; sound-only catches omit touch.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

condition_intermixing.value: Twenty-one catches are interspersed with the 224 target/baseline trials.

ordered_elements_and_source_selection.value: Fixation cross →1000 ms→trial/audio onset; touch at the chosen delay or no touch in catches. Baseline trials omit the sound.

trial_families.value: Audio-tactile targets, tactile-only baselines, auditory-only no-touch catches.

within_trial_timing_or_placement.value: The sound/tactile tracks last 2 s or 3 s; exact trial end, post-response waiting period and separate ITI are not reported.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.value: Press a left-hand response button as soon as the right-palm vibration is felt; withhold on auditory-only catches. RT is keypress time relative to trial onset minus the selected touch delay.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

response_mapping_or_expected_action.value: Speeded press on tactile detection while maintaining fixation.

response_mode_or_device.value: Cherry MX Blue response button within reach of the left hand.

response_window_and_anchor.value: Tactile anchor is explicit, but no numeric online timeout or measured button latency correction is reported.

scoring_rule.value: Negative RTs and trials with multiple presses are excluded. Per-delay/condition RTs beyond 2.5 SD are trimmed offline.

target_and_nontarget_rule.value: Touch requires response; no-touch catch requires withholding.

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.value: The fixation-to-trial-onset interval is fixed at 1000 ms. Independent intertrial timing and post-sound jitter are not specified.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

distribution.value: No independent ITI distribution or range is supplied.

policy_type.value: Fixed foreperiod before trial onset.

randomization.value: Randomization of foreperiod/ITI is not stated; interspersed catch order does not establish timing jitter.

timing_scope_and_anchor.value: 1000 ms after fixation-cross appearance; sound begins at trial onset on sounding trials.

values_or_range.value: 1000 ms fixed foreperiod.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.value: The 3 s protocol uses 375,750,1125,1500,1875,2250,2625 ms after trial/sound onset. Baselines match these seven delays without sound.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6
contracts.evidenceNote: Seven acquisition delays are preserved; the six smoothed analysis positions are not six acquired trial levels.

direction_specific_pairing.value: One right-to-head looming direction. Tactile-only baselines use the same trial-relative delays.

reference_event_and_sign.value: Positive tactile onset after trial/sound onset.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.value: An 80 Hz sawtooth lasts 200 ms and drives an audio-driven haptic actuator under the right palm. Methods disagree about the silicone pad dimensions.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6
contracts.evidenceNote: Methods 2.2 describes a 15×15×1 cm pad; Methods 2.4 describes 10×10×1 cm. Preserve this apparatus discrepancy; 80 Hz and 200 ms are consistently reported.

body_site_and_side.value: Right palm supported on a molded silicone pad.

external_trigger.value: Separate tactile audio track starts simultaneously with the binaural track through the DAC.

frequency_or_amplitude.value: Frequency 80 Hz; pulse duration 200 ms.

intensity_or_calibration.value: Numeric amplitude/displacement and individual tactile-threshold calibration are not reported.

modality.value: Audio-driven vibrotactile actuator.

waveform_and_duration.value: 80 Hz sawtooth synthesized in Audacity, lasting 200 ms.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.value: A full set of tactile-only baselines matches all seven delays, with 16 repetitions per delay and no looming sound.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6
contracts.derivationNote: 7×16=112. Unlike pre/post controls in some earlier papers, this baseline is explicitly a tactile-only condition across the full delay grid.

allocation_rule.value: 16 repetitions at each of seven delays.

crossing_rule.value: Crosses every delay within each duration-specific protocol.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Tactile-only SOA-matched trials.

resolved_trial_count.value: 112 baseline trials per duration protocol.

timing_and_anchor.value: The same seven trial-relative touch onsets as the audio-tactile trials; sound omitted.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.value: Twenty-one catch trials contain only the duration-specific auditory stimulus and require no response.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

allocation_rule.value: Exact additional count of 21 per duration-specific block.

crossing_rule.value: One looming source per duration; catch has no tactile SOA assignment.

family_or_explicit_none.value: Auditory-only withhold catches.

resolved_trial_count.value: 21 per protocol;42 across both duration protocols.

target_role_and_expected_action.value: No tactile stimulation; withhold button press.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.value: 16 repeats×7 delays×2 modalities yields 224 tactile trials;21 additional catches produce 245 per duration protocol. Both protocols together give 490 trials before the separate practice.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6
contracts.evidenceNote: Methods excludes 3 participants in 2 s and 4 in 3 s, consistent with Figure 1's N 10/N 9. Results report modality F(1,8) for 2 s and F(1,9) for 3 s, reversing the apparent subject degrees of freedom. Retain the reported samples and flag the inconsistency; do not invent additional exclusions.
contracts.derivationNote: 7×2×16+21=245. The same 13 participants perform both versions; this does not yield 26 independently recruited participants.

derived_total_reconciliation.value: 112 audio-tactile+112 tactile-only+21 auditory-only=245 per protocol;2×245=490 main trials.

exceptions_or_overrides.value: Five practice trials follow initial tactile demonstration and precede the two experiments. Practice is not counted in 245.

factor_dimensions.value: 7 delays ×2 target modalities (baseline/audio-tactile) within each of two duration protocols.

repetitions_or_exact_counts.value: 16 repetitions per delay and modality;112 per modality;224 total touch trials;21 catches;245 per block.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.value: Each participant performs the 2 s and 3 s protocols, each described as a 245-trial block with two scheduled breaks and a following questionnaire. Seven participants start with 2 s and six start with 3 s.
contracts.pageOrSection: Published Forum Acusticum / EuroNoise 2025 proceedings PDF pp.2–4 (printed 3550–3552), Methods 2.1–2.5; questionnaire Table 1 p.6

block_composition.value: Each protocol:112 audio-tactile targets+112 tactile-only baselines+21 catches.

block_count.value: Two duration-specific protocol blocks per participant, one of each duration.

block_order_or_counterbalancing.value: Semi-counterbalanced duration order:7 participants 2 s first,6 participants 3 s first; questionnaire follows each protocol.

pool_repeat_or_distribution.value: Exact subdivision around the two breaks is not specified.

sequence_constraints.value: No complete delay/modality randomization algorithm, seed, block-position constraints or catch run limits are supplied.

within_block_randomization.value: Catch trials are interspersed.

inventoryAudit.interpretation: Audited means inventory evidence or documented access blocker plus eleven explicit source dispositions per retained row. It does not mean all values are reported, final-version equivalence is proven, a template exists, or native hardware is qualified.
